choices.reason: The paper explicitly calls H1 and H2 its primary hypotheses, and H2 specifies high-agency comparisons with control and low agency. Among the tied AI-versus-control candidates, only high-agency versus control implements that stated primary contrast, so rule 1 resolves the tie.
choices.locator: PDF p. 9, The Present Study, paragraph beginning "We test two primary hypotheses" and H2; PDF pp. 15-16, Homogeneity, operationalizes H2 using similarity to the condition-object centroid.
choices.quote: We test two primary hypotheses. [...] H2: Ideas produced by participants in the high-agency condition will be rated as less homogeneous than ideas produced in the control or low-agency conditions.
